sources.title: Documentation · Voxide
sources.snippet: Voxide is a capability-first Voice AI SDK designed specifically for React and Next.js applications. Instead of building complex backend conversational agents, Voxide allows you to expose your existing client-side JavaScript functions to a Gemini-powered Live AI.

sources.title: AI Function Calling in the Browser: Actions · Voxide
sources.snippet: AI function calling in the browser. Define the capabilities your voice agent can call, parameters, handlers, dangerous actions, and confirmation prompts.

sources.title: Voxide - Fresh Builds
sources.snippet: Voxide is a capability-first voice AI SDK that maps speech/text to real client-side JS functions so sites can be navigated and operated by voice without a custom chat stack. Aimed at React/Next.js (and headless for other frameworks) builders who want function calling, live state binding, and a drop-in widget.

sources.title: GitHub - pmd-coutinho/voxide
sources.snippet: Voxide is a cross-platform desktop dictation app built with Rust and Tauri. Speech is transcribed locally with Whisper (or the speech engine of your choice), optionally cleaned up by an AI provider you configure, and inserted directly into the active application — on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
